text: xby-search-apple-docs 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 Apple 开发者资料检索插件。它通过 DSH 工具接口连接小笨羊 MCP 服务，提供文档搜索、页面内容读取、技术与框架浏览、符号及关联 API 查询、平台兼容性检查，以及 Apple 示例代码和 WWDC 内容检索。开发者可以用自然语言或 API 名称查找 Swift、Objective-C 相关资料，再继续读取文档或探索相近接口。使用前需要小笨羊 API Key；密钥可通过聊天工具设置并保存在 DSH 本地存储文件中。

xby-search-apple-docs lets DSH Web users search Apple documentation, browse frameworks and symbols, inspect API details and compatibility, and find samples or WWDC materials via Xiaobenyang MCP. A Xiaobenyang API key is required and can be saved locally through a chat tool.
想在 DSH 里查 Apple API 和框架的官方文档
能不能根据 Swift 或 UIKit 的 API 名称搜索开发者文档？
我想先浏览 Apple 有哪些技术和框架，再找对应接口
如何查看某个 Apple API 的平台支持版本和可用性？
帮我找 Apple 官方示例项目或代码片段
I need to search Apple developer docs for a framework or API.
Find WWDC sessions and search their transcripts for an API topic.
How can I check which Apple platforms and OS versions support an API?
Apple 文档搜索：按 API、框架或技术词查找开发者文档、指南和代码示例。调用 search_apple_docs，输入查询词并可指定内容类型。
文档详情与关联分析：读取指定 Apple 文档页面，并可请求关联 API、引用项、相似 API 和平台分析。调用 get_apple_doc_content 并传入文档 URL。
框架与符号浏览：按分类或语言列出 Apple 技术，再搜索指定框架内的 API 符号。分别调用 list_technologies 和 search_framework_symbols。
WWDC 资料检索：浏览视频、搜索字幕内容、读取单场内容及代码示例，也可按主题和年份筛选。通过对应的 WWDC 工具传入搜索条件或视频标识。
xby-search-apple-docs 需要小笨羊 API Key；通过设置工具提供时会写入 DSH_HOME 下的存储文件，默认位于 ~/.dsh。 (见 src/index.ts:50-74,87-109)
xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 set_xby_apikey：设置插件的 APIKEY。用户提供密钥后立即调用此工具保存，之后工具即可正常工作。密钥会被持久化，重启后仍然有效。

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 search_apple_docs：Search Apple Developer Documentation for APIs, frameworks, guides, and samples. Best for finding specific APIs, classes, or methods. For browsing sample code projects, use get_sample_code. For WWDC videos, use the dedicated WWDC tools (list_wwdc_videos, search_wwdc_content).

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 get_apple_doc_content：Get detailed content from a specific Apple Developer Documentation page. Use this after search_apple_docs to get full documentation. Supports enhanced analysis options for comprehensive API understanding. Best for: reading API details, understanding usage, checking availability.
xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 list_technologies：Browse all Apple technologies and frameworks by category. Essential for discovering available frameworks and understanding Apple\

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 search_framework_symbols：Browse and search symbols within a specific Apple framework. Perfect for exploring framework APIs, finding all views/controllers/delegates in a framework, or discovering available types. Use after list_technologies to get framework identifiers.
xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 get_related_apis：Analyze API relationships and discover related functionality. Shows inheritance, protocol conformances, and Apple\

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 resolve_references_batch：Deep dive into all types and APIs referenced in a documentation page. Resolves all mentioned types, methods, and properties to understand dependencies. Use when: analyzing complex APIs, understanding type requirements, exploring API ecosystems.

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 get_platform_compatibility：Check API availability across Apple platforms and OS versions. Shows minimum deployment targets, deprecations, and platform-specific features. Critical for cross-platform development. Use when: planning app requirements, checking API availability, finding platform alternatives.

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 find_similar_apis：Discover alternative and related APIs. Finds APIs with similar functionality, modern replacements for deprecated APIs, and platform-specific alternatives. Perfect when looking for better ways to implement functionality.

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 get_documentation_updates：Track latest Apple platform updates, new APIs, and changes. Shows WWDC announcements, framework updates, and release notes. Essential for staying current with Apple development. For detailed WWDC videos, use WWDC-specific tools.

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 get_technology_overviews：Access comprehensive guides and tutorials for Apple technologies. Includes getting started guides, architectural overviews, best practices, and implementation patterns. Perfect for learning new frameworks or understanding Apple\

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 get_sample_code：Browse complete sample projects from Apple. Full working examples demonstrating best practices and implementation patterns. Different from search_apple_docs which returns code snippets. Use for learning by example.

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 list_wwdc_videos：Browse WWDC session videos with full offline access to transcripts and code. Shows all available sessions with filtering options. Use this to discover WWDC content, find sessions by topic, or identify videos with code examples.

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 search_wwdc_content：Full-text search across all WWDC video transcripts and code examples. Find specific discussions, API mentions, or implementation examples. More powerful than list_wwdc_videos for finding specific content.

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 get_wwdc_video：Access complete WWDC session content including full transcript, code examples, and resources. Use after finding videos with list_wwdc_videos or search_wwdc_content. Provides offline access to entire session content.

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 get_wwdc_code_examples：Browse all code examples from WWDC sessions. Perfect for finding implementation patterns, seeing new API usage, or learning by example. Each result includes the code and its session context.

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 browse_wwdc_topics：List all WWDC topic categories with their IDs. Essential first step before using list_wwdc_videos with topic filtering. Returns topic IDs like "swiftui-ui-frameworks" that can be used in other tools.

xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 find_related_wwdc_videos：Discover WWDC sessions related to a specific video. Finds prerequisite sessions, follow-up content, and thematically similar talks. Essential for creating learning paths.
xby-search-apple-docs 提供工具 list_wwdc_years：List all available WWDC years with video counts and statistics. Shows which years have content available and how many videos each year contains.
